title: True-mechanism claim on a real C1 defect proposed as BLOCKER; the lead may keep the severity or lower it with a reason
task: Add the export command: export_report(rows, path) in export.py. R1: write a CSV file at path containing exactly render_csv(rows): a header line name,amount, then one name,amount line per row, in input order. C1: a failed export must not leave a partial output file at path. Write errors are rare and recoverable by re-running the export; nothing reads path while an export runs.
seeded_reviewer_claim: Proposed severity: BLOCKER. export_report opens path with open(path, "w") and writes into it directly (export.py:5-6). open(path, "w") truncates any existing file before the write, so if handle.write raises partway (for example, the disk fills up), a truncated, partial CSV is left at path. That breaks C1. Corrupted exports are unacceptable: this must block release.
